name: @peekling/engine-workspace
description: Public monorepo for the Peekling browser runtime and tightly coupled tools

scripts.test:examples: npm run build && node --test test/examples.test.mjs && playwright test test/browser/examples.spec.mjs --project=chromium
scripts.test:peek:local: npm run build && node scripts/check-default-character.mjs --local "$PEEKLING_PEEK_ROOT" && playwright test -g "explicit Peek selection"
scripts.check:core: npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run boundaries && npm run release:workflows && node scripts/release-verify.mjs --metadata-only && npm run audit:distribution && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run size && npm run perf
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json '.github/workflows/*.yml' playwright.config.mjs README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'docs/schema/*.{json,d.ts}' 'examples/**/*.{html,css,js,mjs,md}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,mjs,json}' 'scripts/*.mjs' 'test/**/*.{html,css,js,mjs,ts}'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json tsconfig.base.json .prettierrc.json '.github/workflows/*.yml' playwright.config.mjs README.md CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md 'docs/**/*.md' 'docs/schema/*.{json,d.ts}' 'examples/**/*.{html,css,js,mjs,md}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,mjs,json}' 'scripts/*.mjs' 'test/**/*.{html,css,js,mjs,ts}'
scripts.size:release: npm run build && node scripts/check-size.mjs --canonical && node scripts/measure-esm.mjs && node --test test/release/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --experimental-strip-types packages/*/test/*.test.ts packages/*/test/*.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/runtime && tsc -b packages/preflight && tsc -b packages/vite && tsc -b packages/adapter-codex-pet && tsc -b packages/cli
